text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — I'm landing a small refactor to the tenant throttle interface this afternoon. The goal is to eliminate double-accounting between ingress-side token buckets and the central quota ledger. Need a quick sanity check before I merge.

AJ Patel: Can you paste the new call shape? worried about extra RPCs on the hotpath.

Maria Chen: Sure, core change is moving a fast-path admit to ingress using a cached snapshot. New RPC stays for authoritative checks. Pseudocode:```proto
service ThrottleService {
  // fast admit: returns decision using cached snapshot 
  rpc FastAdmit(FastAdmitReq) returns (FastAdmitResp);
  // authoritative check / reconciliation 
  rpc CheckAndCharge(CheckReq) returns (CheckResp);
}
```

Sasha Rivera: If ingress starts making admit decisions we can get divergence when abuse flags are toggled centrally. We should define the consistency contract (staleness window + reconciliation frequency).

Kevin Li: We could use a lightweight lease ping to keep counters consistent and also send central flags as part of the snapshot. Adds ~1ms on snapshot refresh but avoids full RPC on every request.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for infra/tenant-throttle-refactor at 15:30 UTC :rocket:

AJ Patel: Telemetry needs: add `ingress_fast_admit_allowed` and `central_reconcile_calls` counters. Also add an `ingress_snapshot_age` gauge.

Maria Chen: Yep adding metrics + a feature flag: THROTTLE_V2_ENABLED to gate rollout. Snapshot TTL default 2s.

Sasha Rivera: Two asks before merge: (1) doc removal plan for the old path (timeline + migration steps) (2) tests for clock skew/clock drift between ingress and central (we saw flakiness in prior experiments).

AJ Patel: sgtm. Quick question: how does this affect the fairness scheduler? do we keep weight calculation central?

Maria Chen: Central remains authoritative for weight assignments. Ingress will use cached weight snapshots to compute a fast admit using the same formula. If central updates weights, we reconcile on the next CheckAndCharge call.

Kevin Li: Edge case: cache TTL means a tenant can briefly exceed probation/penalty windows. Suggest ingress honor a probation flag in the snapshot (central sets probation_expires_ts) so ingress can immediately enforce probation even if weights are stale.

Sasha Rivera: :thumbsup: agree. Also add an integration test toggling probation flag mid-flight to ensure we don't regress.

Maria Chen: I'll update the PR with: (a) snapshot includes flags + probation_expires_ts, (b) metrics, (c) docs + removal plan, (d) unit + integration tests for skew and probation toggle. Will ping infra-sre for a quick review. If no blockers I'll merge this afternoon.

AJ Patel: +1

Kevin Li: Thanks — ping me if you want me to run the canary.

Maria Chen: Will do, thanks everyone.
